name: ieee-paper-doctor
description: Safely convert, audit, and verify multi-file IEEEtran projects for two-column journal submission.

interface.shortDescription: Audit and convert multi-file IEEEtran projects.
interface.longDescription: Discover and audit a multi-file IEEEtran LaTeX project, apply conservative one-column-to-two-column fixes through a reviewable diff, compile it, and report remaining layout risks without rewriting scientific content.
defaultPrompt: Convert my IEEEtran draft to a safe two-column journal submission.
Scan this multi-file IEEEtran project and produce a Markdown audit report.
